title: Describe the Painting
summary: Given a painting represented by overlapping segments with unique colors, create a description using the minimum number of non-overlapping segments where each segment's color is the sum of the mixed colors.
statement: Given a painting represented by overlapping segments with unique colors, create a description using the minimum number of non-overlapping segments where each segment's color is the sum of the mixed colors. The input is a 2D array of segments, and the output is a 2D array describing the painting with mixed colors, where each segment is a half-closed interval [left, right) with the sum of the mixed colors. Overlapping segments are merged into a single segment with the sum of their colors. The output segments can be in any order, and a half-closed segment [a, b) includes point a but not point b.
constraints: segments contains 1 through 20000 triples [start, end, color].
1 <= start < end <= 100000 and colors are distinct positive integers up to 1000000000.
Return the minimal nonoverlapping half-open intervals with positive mixed color sum in any order.
hints: Only a segment endpoint can change the active color sum.
Store +color at each start and -color at each end, then sweep endpoints in order while carrying the current sum.
Before applying the delta at point x, emit [previous,x,current] when current is positive; merge an adjacent equal-sum interval.
The active set is constant between consecutive endpoints, so its sum is correct throughout that interval; merging equal adjacent sums produces the minimum description.
editorial: The active set is constant between consecutive endpoints, so its sum is correct throughout that interval; merging equal adjacent sums produces the minimum description.

tests.explanation: The mixed sums are fourteen on [1,4) and sixteen on [4,7).
